summary: Phase 2 Vision Document for Kallaway expansion extraction. Identifies three new skill domains from the 2026 social media strategy transcript: AI-Enabled Creativity (Sandcastles + Claude workflow architecture), Social Commerce 3.0 (four monetization tailwinds and the value-of-distribution thesis), and Premium Storytelling Architecture (five-pillar system for narrative-driven content). Includes uniqueness audit against existing 4 Kallaway domains, business leverage matrix, cross-expert stacking map, and gap-fill analysis. Proposes 10 new workflows across two new skill directories.
